facts: Parties: Dunmore Media Ltd (Buyer), Corrib Robotics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Orwell Foods Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 28 July 2026; Closing is scheduled for 11 November 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 28 July 2026), either party may terminate.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 10 December 2026.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Northgate Medical Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
